Text: Go home and talk to Screwdriver!
So... Do you guys not play at all anymore?
Party! Party! The night is ours!
Yes!!! Pour me a strong one!
You want me to run your errands!?
Where do I even find candy?
You should sing again if it is your dream!
Yeah, working sucks! Let's all party all night forever!!!!
I just didn't think pests could read...
My human reads to me! That's why!
But it's impressive you taught yourself!
I assumed you'd rather be hunting or something!
Well, [shake]I[/shake] never called you a mouse!
You'd be lucky to be called a mouse!
Do you not know where you are...?
Yes. this is outside. Very much.
Why aren't you in a cage anyways?
Do you live in a cage then..?
But... shouldn't you be inside a hamster ball...?
Okay..why aren't you in your enclosure?
Why do you love lamps so much?
I will give you two some privacy...
